title: Wright's Orchard Station Campground

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Reservations are very highly recommended -if traveling please call before arrival. Weekly rates for RV sites are discounted from the daily rate and are calculated as paying for 6 days and staying 7 days. Monthly rates are subject to availability. Electric is included in the monthly rental price (Summer Season - Winter Season will have an increased electric charge). Please call for the details and availability. blurb: Our campground is ideally situated for all RVers and campers who are visiting the Central Pennsylvania area. Located on the edge of Altoona, PA, we are just a short drive to both State College, PA, and Johnstown, PA.
